blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday named Social Security System (SSS) president and chief executive officer Robert Joseph Montes de Claro as the new secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). De Claro will replace Henry Aguda, whose resignation was confirmed by Marcos during a press briefing over the weekend. /dp READ: Ombudsman: DICT chief Aguda has resigned “I’ve already signed the interim appointment of the new DICT secretary, who is Robert Joseph de Claro,” Marcos said during a brief question-and-answer portion on the sidelines of the oath-taking ceremony of newly elected officers of the Malacañang […]...
